title: Symthaea typed tractable-circuit IR
description: Typed finite pseudo-Boolean function DAG. This draft schema describes the reference subset, not an external proof format.

q.encoding: reduced exact rational with positive denominator

pmc.output: number of distinct assignments to visible variables with Boolean support

pwmc.output: exact sum of visible-assignment weights over distinct supported projections

wmc.output: exact sum of root function values over full assignments

amc-complex.output: exact sum of Q(i) root function values over full assignments

sum.optional_invariant: when deterministic=true, terms have disjoint nonzero support

circuit.topology: Nodes are listed in topological order. All references point to earlier nodes. The root may have a scope smaller than the declared variable universe; omitted variables are free and are enumerated by the reference evaluator.
circuit.projection: visible is a subset of variables and is only valid for pmc/pwmc. Hidden-variable support is existentially collapsed by collecting distinct visible tuples, not by adding witness counts.
circuit.pwmc_weights: visible_weights maps visible variable IDs to [false_weight, true_weight], each an exact rational pair. The default pair is [1,1] for both polarities.
